title: Sheets collapse whenever a waiting reason line shows
detail: Before first count, Edit record (both), Lock blocked and End task (active sows): the body clips mid-row, the hint overlaps Litter summary, tiles are cut, and the reason line sits flush at x=0. Fix: put the reason in the footer's status slot, not the scrolling body.

title: Unit hub figures disagree with the Inspection page they open
detail: Gestation Unit 7 hub says 'Checked Yesterday, 16:10' and Health 3; tapping it opens Inspection with 'Last check-in 06:40 · G. Hansen' and Health 4. Fix: read both from one source.

title: Progress label says 'complete' over a 1 of 8 bar
detail: Piglet processing reads 'All scheduled items complete · 1 / 8 pens' (work-due adds '4 litters with care due' above it); Breeding reads 'Service sequences complete · 1 / 8 sows'. Fix: name what the bar counts ('Pens done').

title: Home uses the banned verb Complete for ending tasks
detail: 'Review & complete task' opens 'Ready to complete … Complete the task', whose button says End task; closed cards read 'Completed', the receipt 'Task complete'. strings.json bans Complete: tasks are ended. Fix: 'End task', 'Ready to end', 'Ended · Today'.

title: Waiting reason is one generic sentence that fits nothing
detail: Before first count, Edit record and the empty death drawer all say 'Complete the required fields first'; none has required fields, and 'Complete' is banned. Fix: say the one step that makes the button live ('Count the first piglet', 'Change a count to save', 'Add a death').

title: Prototype disclaimers are written into the product copy
detail: PREVIEW badges, 'Apply preview setting', 'Save sample issue', 'Issue resolved in this preview', 'Sample readings · …' sit inside the phone. As the spec, these become shipped strings. Fix: product verbs inside the phone; keep the demo disclaimer outside it.

title: Fan speed is a thin slider, hard with gloves
detail: A 0-100 range slider in steps of 5 needs a precise drag; it is not one of the DS fields. Fix: a Stepper (−/+ 5%, 48px keys) with the value in mono.

title: 'Awaiting' lens label breaks mid-word below 390px
detail: In the demo page at 390 and 360 viewports the phone is 344-360 wide and the lens reads 'Awaitin / g'. Fix: apply the Segments copy budget (drop counts first) or let the filter button shrink; never break a word.

title: No Chinese rendering, so zh fit cannot be checked
detail: Farrowing, Home and Environment prototypes render English only; no lang switch exists, though strings.json holds zh. Long zh labels on lenses, tiles and hold captions are untested. Fix: a ?lang=zh switch on each prototype.

title: Receipt has two exits and an off-format stamp
detail: Footer holds 'Back' and 'Back to Today' (Home's tab is 'Home'); the stamp '10 Oct, 03:23 · G. Hansen' uses the device clock and a third date format beside 'Aug 27 at 08:12' and 'Thu, 8 Jul'.
recommendation: One exit 'Back' and the ruled stamp; the receipt is a dead end either way.

title: Is End task red or ink?
detail: The README says 'End task' is red-filled; farrowing's all-finished End task and Home's Ready to complete draw it ink, while End task early is red. One verb, two colours.
options: Red only for End early; ink for a normal end (update README)
recommendation: Red only for End early: a normal end loses nothing; update the README line.

title: Today's date is amber with no meaning
detail: 'Thu, 8 Jul' beside Today's work is amber on every Home view; amber means due now or waiting to upload. Fix: muted.

title: Active is light green on the bar, blue on rows
detail: Whole-task progress draws Active as pale green, but the row chip uses the progress blue; green means done. 'Current unit' under Unit 7 is 9px, below the 10px floor. Fix: progress colour for Active; meta size for the note.

title: Home and Farrowing name the same states differently
detail: Home's card says '2 sows farrowing' and 'Farrowings recorded 7 / 18'; one tap later the task says '2 active' and '7 / 18 Farrowed'. Fix: Home uses the task's words (Active, Farrowed).

title: A lone Back is drawn as the ink primary
detail: Choose unit and the resolved issue drawer show a full-width ink 'Back' beside the head ✕. Ink fill is for the act; Back takes back-border. Fix: secondary Back, or the ✕ alone.

title: Toolbox and Scan carry study links and demo text
detail: Toolbox lists 'Shared component study ↗', 'Task card gallery ↗' and 'Records · Updates made in this preview'; Scan says 'Scanner preview… Use a sample tag'. Fix: move study links and disclaimers outside the phone.

title: Equipment faults reported from two doors under two names
detail: The farrowing pen sheet offers 'Report equipment fault'; Environment offers 'Report issue' / 'Report equipment issue' for the same record. Fix: one noun ('issue') and one drawer, reached from both.

title: Environment strip units are 9px, below the floor
detail: On the unit hub '°C', '%' and 'ppm NH₃' render at 9px; meta at 10px is the floor and units must always be readable. Fix: 10px or larger.

title: Temperature named twice above one value
detail: The selected tab says Temperature and the card repeats 'Temperature' over 22.4 °C. Fix: drop the card label; the tab names it.

title: Hold caption differs from Farrowing's for the same act
detail: Home's End task early button is captioned 'HOLD TO END'; Farrowing's is 'HOLD TO END EARLY'. Fix: one caption per verb from strings.json.
